payload.supporting_quote: Compared with controls, women with migraine had lower serum 25(OH)D and calcium levels (p ≤ 0.001)

payload.symptoms: High-frequency episodic migraine or chronic migraine (HF/CM)
payload.supporting_quote: Mean 25(OH)D levels in females with HF/CM (median [interquartile range] 19.0 [13.0-24.5] ng/mL) were below the values considered for insufficiency or deficiency and significantly lower than controls (25.0 [19-29.8] ng/mL; p < 0.0001)

The median serum 25(OH)D was 56 nmol/L (IQR 41, 69) in children with headaches and 70 nmol/L (IQR 50, 95) in children with epilepsy. Vitamin D insufficiency was present in 42% of children with headaches and 25% of children with epilepsy
No significant association was found between migraine and serum 25(OH)D. Non-migraine headache was associated with low levels of serum 25(OH)D.
